name: Strip Steak & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed and slice into thin strips. Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ medium red onion
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.

Once the steak has been transferred, reduce the heat to medium and add sliced onion, peppers, and ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the guacamole) to the skillet. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry cilantro and limes. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

Halve and pit avocados; medium dice the flesh while still in skin and scoop out into a medium bowl. Add ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing), remaining garlic, lime juice, salt, and pepper. Mash with a fork until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 avocados
juice of 1 ½ limes
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Add steak slices and any juices to skillet. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook for 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp cumin
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In another skillet or pan, warm tortillas for 20-30 seconds per side if desired.
To serve, place tortillas on a plate and fill with fajita filling. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!
